summary.en: United Therapeutics combines pulmonary medicines and new-indication filings with gene-edited organ transplantation programs. Treprostinil and ralinepag are its principal near-term regulatory opportunities.
summary.zh: United Therapeutics将肺部药物和新适应症申报与基因编辑器官移植项目相结合。曲前列尼尔和ralinepag是其近期主要的监管机会。

ind.en: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; also Phase 3 progressive pulmonary fibrosis
ind.zh: 特发性肺纤维化;另有III期进行性肺纤维化

target.en: Gene-edited porcine kidney replacement with thymic tissue
target.zh: 基因编辑猪肾联合胸腺组织替代

watch.en: IPF and ralinepag FDA decisions are expected in April and June 2027; TETON-PPF results in H2 2027.
watch.zh: IPF和ralinepag的FDA决定预计于2027年4月和6月公布;TETON-PPF结果预计于2027年下半年公布。

watch.en: Ralinepag approval requires resolution of deficiencies at API supplier ScinoPharm.
watch.zh: Ralinepag获批需要解决原料药供应商ScinoPharm的缺陷。

watch.en: Settlements permit Orenitram generics from June and December 2027, subject to earlier-entry conditions.
watch.zh: 和解协议允许Orenitram仿制药自2027年6月和12月起上市,但须符合提前进入的条件。

watch.en: Tyvaso generated $503.8 million of $832.5 million Q3 revenue.
watch.zh: Tyvaso贡献了第三季度8.325亿美元收入中的5.038亿美元。

gaps: Xenografts use modality other and functional organ-replacement descriptions for target; conventional numeric phases are not applicable or not established.
UKidney has an ongoing combined Phase 1/2/3, described as phaseless; its phase is null to avoid implying conventional late-stage maturity.
UThymoKidney and UHeart have IND clearance; current enrollment and numeric stages were not verified.
Several discovery origins and treprostinil receptor details were not verified.
Treprostinil delivery variants are consolidated into one asset; proposed new clinical formulations are not counted separately.
